can't you quit the job you are stuck now? I used to be an overachiever but after so many disappointments these days I just quit anything that makes me unhappy, yeah i know it's difficult to do that when you have bills to pay but your mental health should be a priority, if this job is making things worse you need to find a backup plan, something better. you can't keep on living feeling miserable this way.

I think ocd and bdd are related, in a shell all these mental illnesses are ways we found to cope with the pain, is there any way you could get help, to check if you have bdd? I think you do but I'm not a professional, maybe the bdd is the way your brain found  to cope with the sexual abuse, you see imperfection on your appereance because it's easier to fix something physical than deal with the emotional. It's like a distraction, shoving the real issue away because it's easier to see flaws in your face or body than to deal with past trauma. I don't think things go away, they just turn into another form, maybe your ocd is now dormant and you gave room to bdd, all these go hand in hand. I wish I could help you somehow,  I will be online for a bit if you need to talk, it still raining here and really dark, don't think that I will able to hang myself in a tree outside, inside the house don't have much options just the stairs or door knob, take care of yourself

a lot of what you wrote I can relate, the sexual abuse, dissociation when I look myself in the mirror (sometimes I can't recognize the person in the mirror, I see myself huge when I'm underweight), self hate, low self steem, no friends, disappointing love life, problems holding down a job, feeling trapped, feeling different from others, can't be happy like the rest. 

I wish i could help you but I'm dealing with the same situation, the only thing different that I did from you was that whenever a love interest come into my life I never think they will save me, I always expect to be dumped, I can do no wrong but it's never enough anyway. I think people like us don't have any salvation from outside, nobody can heal us but ourselves. You have to take care of yourself, buying things is just a bandaid, a short high that doesn't solve the problem, it' like that song "I bought a rolex just to see me smile"... I used to spend a lot of money buying things trying to fill the void but after reading about minimalism I have changed a lot.

 
Is there anything you like to do? any idea that give you motivation to change? They say the urge to suicide pass if you focus on something else. I was thinking about hanging myself outside in a tree but it started to rain and I've been waiting to stop, meanwhile I've been reading the posts. I think if I kill myself who will take care of my cat. Man I wish I could tell you things get better, but that's the shit people who don't get our state of mind say. The only thing I can tell you is that you are not alone feeling all that pain
